description: Result message with an optional contextual action; position and duration are set by the app.

howToUse: Use it for a short result at the edge of the screen, with an optional action such as "Undo" or "View".
Your application decides where it appears and when it leaves; it does not close by itself.
Keep the text to one line and the action to one verb.
alternatives: Several messages that stack and close by time: Toast.
A message tied to a section of the page: Callout.

keyboard.action: Moves to the action, when there is one.
